name: bottle weighted swing
description: A hip-driven swing with a weighted bottle held in both hands. It trains the glutes and hamstrings explosively.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding a bottle with both hands.
Hinge back and let the bottle swing between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bottle swing to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed, the hips do the work.
Let it fall back and hinge into the next rep.
